entry.title: Introducing the Enigma Registry
entry.summary: The Enigma Registry is the signed catalogue Sanctum ships with. Here is what it contains, what each signature proves, and how to publish a registry of your own.

entry.title: Personal software, on your terms
entry.summary: Software is now cheap to build, and a single HTML file is the easiest thing to share. Sanctum runs those files with the access you approve and nothing more.
